criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Slides 1, 9, 8 and 5 pass most of the stage. Slides 2, 7, 6, 3 and 4 fall on a default or a primitive. Label halos on 2, 5, 6 and 7 are soft plates.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One key honoured and two working devices, camera walk and accent. The fence motif doesn't register and the value track strobes at 2, 6 and 8.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every printed numeral traces. Slide 6 drew four stakes for 50 MW. Slide 5's headline drops up to.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where, condition and deadline named, the letter of intent kept honest. The next step is general.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe and 5 is a real turn. The land carries three frames.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean, attribution cadence, no place texture in the copy.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: New cover, unit and accent. lastLight again and several echoes.

hard_fails: Slide 6 rendered four stakes against 10 MW a stake for a 50 MW phase.
Curly apostrophes in published slide copy on slides 2 and 4.
one_sentence_fix: Relight the two reliefs and frame 6's ground as Caprock earth in a dark pool, and drive frame 6's stake count from sections_phase1.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A rippled lake ground, plank flags, four stakes, an unlit substation.
